messages:
Nina Patel: Handing off EmberGrid (enterprise) to CS + Eng. Closed today; committed 9-month term with Dedicated + Private setup.

Nina Patel: Sales summary:
```
account: EmberGrid (enterprise)
primary contact: max@embergrid.io (Head of Platform)
needs: dedicated pool, VPC peering, SAML (Okta), audit logging to customer SIEM
expected load: ~50 qps steady, spikes to ~400 qps for 10min bursts
SLO: p95 < 180ms for interactive endpoints
contract notes: short ramp to GA + optional expansion after 3 months
```

Owen Brooks: I can take CS lead. Immediate asks from my side: IdP metadata, network CIDRs, list of service accounts needing access, and if they require egress restrictions. Also want the list of models they'll run for pilot.

Eve Nakamura: @DevRel-Bot please open ENG ticket for private deployment + SIEM integration. Include requested throughput and audit log sink.

DevRel-Bot: Created ENG-8401: "EmberGrid private deploy + SAML + SIEM". Owners: eng-runtime, eng-network. Priority: high. Link: https://internal/ENG-8401

Owen Brooks: Owners and timeline proposal:
- Sales to send IdP metadata + admin contact (Nina) by 2024-05-03
- CS kickoff scheduled by Owen target 2024-05-06
- ENG sizing and staging env ready by 2024-05-14
- SIEM log forwarding PoC by 2024-05-21
- Pilot verification window 2024-06-01 to 2024-06-14

Nina Patel: Max asked for audit logs delivered to Splunk; they'll share index and API key. Security team will want a runbook for incident responses. They prefer weekly status updates.

Eve Nakamura: For ENG-8401 I'll need model family, peak token rates, whether they will use streaming, and whether they plan to use KV caching. Owen, please ask Max for sample payloads and estimated concurrency.

Owen Brooks: Will collect sample payloads in kickoff. Also planning a short pre-kickoff questionnaire to reduce back-and-forth (IdP, network, models, compliance). Will post questionnaire here.

Nina Patel: Renewal risk: moderate if pilot delayed; customer has an internal compliance freeze periods later in quarter which could push approvals. Recommend setting a firm approval deadline and communicating risks to Sales Ops.

Eve Nakamura: I'll add a SIEM checklist to ENG-8401 and a small troubleshooting playbook for common SSO issues. Also will stub a support escalation matrix for CS->Support handoff.

Owen Brooks: CS enablement plan: 30-min kickoff, followed by 1-hour technical deep dive with eng runtime. Post-kickoff CS will run weekly health reports and collect feedback via a short survey after pilot.

DevRel-Bot: ENG-8401 updated: owners assigned and initial checklist added.

Owen Brooks: Next actions (owners):
1) Nina: confirm contact + send IdP metadata by 5/03
2) Owen: send pre-kickoff questionnaire and schedule kickoff for 5/06
3) Eve/eng: post sizing ask and SIEM requirements in ENG-8401 by 5/07
4) CS: prepare support playbook draft by 5/20

Nina Patel: Intro email to Max sent, cc Owen + Eve. Max replied: "We'll get IdP metadata and Splunk details by end of week."

Owen Brooks: Great. I'll post the questionnaire here in the morning and update ENG-8401 with the kickoff invite. Reopening thread for kickoff invites.
